unit.why: A single narrative in which a leader of the Council of Four Lands tests the Besht, is shown his clairvoyance twice, and comes to him.

stories.start_quote: בעת אסיפת ד׳ ארצות היה הפרנס
stories.end_quote: שמעתם מה שהוא אומר ומיד בא לפניו
stories.summary_en: R. Abraham Abba, head of the Council of Four Lands, summons the Besht, suspecting him of being an ignoramus. He tests him on the law for forgetting Ya'aleh ve-Yavo, and the Besht reveals that the rabbi himself will forget it again. The rabbi then secretly follows him to an inn, where the Besht senses that his bed was defiled by the host's son-in-law with a gentile woman, and the rabbi comes to him.

tags.why: A skeptical communal leader is won over to the Besht.
